app.name: Flashcards
app.tagline: An AI answer, turned into a deck you can practise

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.summary: Copy the ready-made prompt into your own AI chat

paste.name: Paste
paste.summary: Paste the answer and check the cards before saving

practise.name: Practise
practise.summary: Go through the deck in a random order

home.title: Three steps to a deck
home.lede: Copy the prompt into your own AI chat together with your study material, paste the answer here, and practise the cards in a random order. You never write a card by hand.
home.privacy: This app is not connected to an AI. Your study material stays on your own computer — only the finished answer is pasted in.

decks.title: No decks yet
decks.body: Your first deck appears once you paste an AI answer in step two. There are no cards to write by hand.

paste.title: Nothing pasted yet
paste.body: Take the prompt from step one, let the AI pull the terms out of your material, and paste the whole answer here.

error.title: That did not work
error.body: The server did not answer. Try again — anything you pasted is still here.

card.hidden: The meaning stays hidden until you reveal it
